info.name: Legendary Entertainment WordPress REST block-directory media API

description.content:
Read-oriented content API exposed by legendary.com: the WordPress REST API (namespace wp/v2) serving Legendary Entertainment news posts, pages, media, categories and tags. Derived by API Evangelist from the live route discovery document at https://www.legendary.com/wp-json/wp/v2 . This is the platform API exposed by the marketing site, NOT a documented first-party Legendary developer program. GET collections are publicly readable without authentication; write operations require WordPress Application Password credentials.
